entries.1400b8f46c9eb776: This is one of the reportable segments and includes the following businesses. In addition to the Bio, Healthcare and Medical Informatics Business, which develops and sells pharmaceuticals, health foods and cosmetics using natural amino acid 5-ALA (5-aminolevulinic acid), it includes businesses tackling advanced Web3-related fields, renewable energy, human resources and media. Consolidated subsidiaries include SBI Pharma Co., Ltd., SBI Alapromo Co., Ltd., SBI Biotech Co., Ltd. and SBI NeoMedia Holdings Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership ratio of 80.0%), and equity-method affiliates include Mynavi Corporation (20.0%, became an equity-method affiliate in November 2024). The Web3-related business acquires and holds crypto assets as validator rewards. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥51,519 million, the fourth largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 83.2% year on year to ¥56,182 million.

entries.7863e2f84bc5bd57: This business provides crypto asset exchange and trading services as a crypto asset exchange service provider and others. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary SBI VC Trade Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership ratio of 100.0%, all held indirectly) and B2C2 LTD in the United Kingdom (90.0%, all held indirectly). SBI VC Trade has also obtained licenses for electronic payment instrument transaction services and Type I financial instruments business, in addition to crypto asset exchange services. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥89,319 million, the third largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 10.9% year on year to ¥89,615 million, a record high. The company cites fluctuations in crypto asset prices and other factors. SBI VC Trade has expanded its retail customer base through M&A and is also strengthening its business for corporate clients.
entries.7b0874e5223b29da: This business provides investment management, including the establishment, offering and management of investment trusts, as well as investment advisory services and the provision of financial product information. It is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries including SBI Asset Management Group Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership ratio of 100.0%), SBI Global Asset Management Co., Ltd. (57.6%) and SBI Asset Management Co., Ltd. (97.9%). SBI Global Asset Management originated from Morningstar Co., Ltd., whose shares were acquired in July 2004. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥40,356 million, the smallest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 23.1% year on year to ¥41,634 million, and the company cites growth in assets under management at each company against a backdrop of a strong domestic stock market as a factor. The company is strengthening its product and service delivery through alliances with leading global asset managers and by using AI agents to manage risk and improve operational efficiency.
